meta.name: postgresql-table-design
meta.description: Use this skill when designing or reviewing a PostgreSQL-specific schema. Covers best-practices, data types, indexing, constraints, performance patterns, and advanced features

copy.tagline: 设计出规范高效的Postgres表结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在为应用设计或审查Postgres表结构,并希望用上实践验证过的方案
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing or reviewing PostgreSQL table schemas and want practical guidance.

howto.what: 让 Claude 按 PostgreSQL 的规则帮你设计或审查表结构:选字段类型、主键、约束和索引,判断大表是否分区,并给出可直接用的建表 SQL 示例。
howto.when: 当你设计新的 PostgreSQL 表结构、上线前审查 schema,或要为字段挑选类型、键与索引时,它接管。

say.text: 帮我设计一张 PostgreSQL 的订单表
say.note: 会给出字段类型与建表 SQL

say.text: 检查这个 schema 的索引和约束
say.note: 会指出缺失的外键索引等问题

say.text: 这张上亿行的大表要不要分区
say.note: 会按分区键和查询条件判断

howto.what_en: Claude designs or reviews PostgreSQL schemas with you: picking column types, keys, constraints and indexes, judging whether to partition, and producing CREATE TABLE SQL examples.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you design a new PostgreSQL schema, review one before it ships, or choose column types, keys and indexes for PostgreSQL.

say_en.text: Design a PostgreSQL orders table for me
say_en.note: Returns column types and CREATE TABLE SQL

say_en.text: Check this schema's indexes and constraints
say_en.note: Flags missing FK indexes and other issues
Judges by partition key and query filters
